query: data, emnlp, john x morris
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.corpus_id,
       p.title,
       p.abstract,
       p.canonical_venue,
       p.venue,
       p.year,
       p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
LEFT JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
LEFT JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
WHERE p.canonical_venue = 'EMNLP'
  AND (
        p.title ILIKE '%data%' OR
        p.abstract ILIKE '%data%' OR
        a.name ILIKE '%john x morris%'
      )
ORDER BY
  (CASE
     WHEN a.name ILIKE '%john x morris%' THEN 3
     WHEN p.title ILIKE '%data%' THEN 2
     WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%data%' THEN 1
     ELSE 0
   END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

       p.title,

  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%parsing the%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%parsing the%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100
